p1Decision.summary: Excel-backed Maxima 2T premix wording and Kerb Weight label were adopted with seven-language synchronization. The unsupported footpeg material/performance highlight and image provenance remain pending.
No image path or asset was changed. All 11 currently referenced image assets remain Pending because configuration, model-level identity anchor and derivation chain are not closed.

Direct Excel conflicts were corrected for wheelbase, ground clearance, seat height, kerb-weight terminology, transmission, lighting, endurance condition and XFH300 engine naming, including repeated public copy and seven-language keys. All 10 image assets and the headlight/footpeg structure conflicts remain Pending.

The Excel speed condition was restored to the 100 km endurance selling point with seven-language synchronization. Starter-battery meaning, unsupported extensions and all 10 image identity/source-chain decisions remain Pending.

Lighting was reduced to the Excel-supported minimum of no standard lights with optional lighting. Battery, displacement, exact configuration and all image identity/source-chain questions remain Pending.
